decisions.reason: This software fits the firm's move toward connected, data-driven infrastructure management and was visible as a standalone offer beyond launch, so it likely supports both project delivery and recurring service business.

The safety manhole door is a more niche hardware add-on that disappeared from the website quickly and is less aligned with the firm's strategic shift toward software, automation, and digital operations.

Control technology for water engineering machinery is close to the firm's core systems integration business and likely remains valuable as a standardized module even if it was no longer marketed prominently as a separate product.
Flow measurement automation and system software matches the firm's core offer and future direction in secure, web-based, operational data solutions for infrastructure operators.
